parallelization.rationale: The loop can stop successfully only from the final cleaned commit after every registered gate passes.

tasks.title: Prove all targets and finish the improvement loop
tasks.action: MUST run the complete frozen native Windows image matrix and three-run native Windows plus headed WASM performance matrix on final HEAD; MUST rerun every focused renderer, editable, TextArea, SelectionArea, table, DataTable, privacy, API, format, clippy, and source-guard validation; MUST prove light-mode quality parity, all reproduced p50 and p95 duration ratios no greater than 0.25, all non-reproduced ratios no greater than 1.05, and every work-count and behavior gate; MUST validate the loop, attach raw measurements and diagnostics to the final experiment, commit the accepted final result, stop the loop with status success and the exact stable commit, and print the repository rollback command; MUST leave the loop incomplete instead of weakening a target when any gate fails or maxIterations is exhausted.
ownedScope: final Test Suite quality and performance outputs
final accepted production and test scopes
forbiddenScope: threshold, fixture, manifest, sample protocol, or baseline change
success stop with a failed or missing gate
compile-only, screenshot-only, smoke-only, mean-only, or one-target proof
acceptanceCriteria: Every native light-mode image gate passes at every scale and the final crop meets the supplied readability target.
Every reproduced TextArea, SelectionArea, DataTable, and shell scenario has final p50 and p95 no greater than 25 percent of baseline for owned CPU work and input-to-published-frame duration.
Every non-reproduced target and unaffected scenario remains within 5 percent of baseline.
All renderer, layout, editing, selection, table, privacy, API, native, WASM, static, and complexity validation passes on final HEAD.
The loop validates and stops with status success, final stable commit, raw final artifacts, failed-experiment ledger, and exact rollback command.
